chapter_title: Concerning the Nourishment of the Person, for ther
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:**

[GAP-1] There exists [GAP-2] continually within the composite of the natural mind of a person [GAP-3] there is an immense fullness of confirmed interior states sealed in order within it [GAP-4] there is a corresponding fullness of governing principles [GAP-5] these are purified from falsity and cleansed from evil, and they enter [GAP-6] by means of interior perception, by means of Divine truth revealed, and by [GAP-7] the stilling of self-derived thought in the peace that comes when the will [GAP-8] is opened to the influx of the Divine Love itself.

**¶2:**

Likewise, the twelve [GAP-9] governing falsities that belong to the domain of spiritual darkness shall be cast out from the interiors into the exteriors — into states of vastation and passage through successive judgments [GAP-10] certain among them [GAP-11: through] this process of vastation, and certain others among them shall be reclaimed and restored to spiritual order.

---

**Translator's note:** The "two hundred and fifty thousand" appearing twice suggests a mirrored fullness — one set of confirmed states belonging to order, one set of governing principles belonging to disorder — the dual structure of regeneration, in which what is of heaven is sealed inward and what is of hell is progressively subordinated. The "twelve rulers of Darkness" correspond to the complete structure of falsity from evil that must be removed in fullness before the interiors can be opened. The "voice, word, and silence" sequence traces the path of Divine truth from external hearing to interior reception to the cessation of the proprium — the deepest state, in which the will rests in the Divine without self-activity.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [The light] exists [and comes] daily to the body of the person [and] there are two hundred and fifty thousand seals in it [And with them] there are another two hundred and fifty thousand rulers [and] they are cleansed and purified and enter [into the rest] by the voice, by the word, and by the [thought that grows] quiet with the silence at the time when his heart [is opened to the love] of God the Father.

Also, the twelve [signs of the zodiac and their] rulers that belong to the Darkness shall be swept out outside in wandering and in transmigration [and in perdition, and] some of them [shall pass through] this transmigration, and others among them shall be brought back.

fills.explanation: In Manichaean cosmology the divine light is the subject that exists and comes continually to the body; it corresponds to the Divine truth that flows into the natural mind in Swedenborg's system.
The spiritual reading says the light exists "continually within" the person; in the Kephalaia's natural register, light "comes daily to the body" describes this ongoing influx.
A simple conjunction bridges from the introductory clause about the body to the enumeration of the seals within it, following standard Kephalaia paratactic style.

The spiritual reading says there is a "corresponding fullness" of governing principles alongside the seals; "with them" captures this parallel/corresponding relationship between the two sets of 250,000.
A conjunction links the enumeration of the rulers to their purification, reflecting the direct transition in the spiritual reading from governing principles to their being purified.

In the Kephalaia, purified light-elements "enter the rest" (anapausis); this is the standard Manichaean destination for what is cleansed, corresponding to the state where the will rests in the Divine without self-activity.

The spiritual reading identifies this as "the stilling of self-derived thought"; in the voice-word-silence triad, the third element is the thought/mind that grows quiet — the cessation of the proprium in natural-plane vocabulary.

The spiritual reading says "the will is opened to the influx of the Divine Love itself"; in the Kephalaia's register, the heart (= will) being opened to the love of God the Father expresses this reception of Divine influx.

fills.explanation: In Manichaean cosmology the twelve zodiacal signs and their ruling archons form the complete dark structure governing material existence; pairing signs with rulers is standard Kephalaia vocabulary for the full structure of falsity from evil.

The spiritual reading's "successive judgments" maps to the series wandering-transmigration; "perdition" extends this standard Kephalaia eschatological triad for the fate of dark powers, while the conjunction transitions to the differentiation of fates.

The spiritual reading confirms these rulers go "through this process of vastation"; "shall pass through" naturally precedes "this transmigration" and contrasts with those who "shall be brought back," expressing the dual fate of destruction versus reclamation.
